andrew (platform): quick heads-up — dependency vuln popped during our image build audit: CVE-2025-9876 in libtar 2.1.0 -> fix available in 2.1.3

maya (eng-sec): CVE id and vector? public exploitability? :eyes:

andrew (platform): CVE-2025-9876, path traversal + archive extraction when untrusted tar input processed. Repro requires authenticated access to our builder API. So initial vector is internal, but if an attacker can get code into artifacts they could sign/publish compromised builds — so customer-facing exposure = moderate.

olivia (sre): does patch require downtime for hosted endpoints / inference serving?

andrew (platform): serving nodes don’t use libtar. Only builder fleet and artifact signer talk to libtar. Rolling restart of ~120 builder hosts required. No impact to inference runtime, but CI/ingest builds will queue for ~10–15m during each host restart window.

jordan (acct): enterprise contracts: any maintenance >15m per tenant needs 48h notice for Dedicated customers. We should surface this early.

maya (eng-sec): proposed schedule: canary to internal (redwood-internal) + 3 partner accounts during Tue 02:00-03:00 UTC. If clean, broad rollout Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC in 30m rolling batches. Notify Dedicated customers with 72h heads-up and offer opt-out for scheduled slot.

andrew (platform): rollout steps I suggest:
1) build patch into our image-builder container (1hr)
2) canary on 3 builders (10m)
3) run artifact validation and signature checks
4) rolling restart with `sleep 30` between hosts

Example quick restart command we’ll use:
```bash
for h in $(cat builders-to-restart.txt); do
  ssh $h sudo systemctl restart image-builder && sleep 30
done
```

olivia (sre): add runbook note to pause autoscaling on builder autoscaler during restart window to avoid churn. Also collect `journalctl -u image-builder -n 200` after each restart for a quick health check.

maya (eng-sec): we should also add transient RBAC audit logging for the builder API during the rollout to catch any anomalous requests. Suggest enabling verbose auth logs for 72h and hooking to our SIEM rule `builders-unusual-extract`.

andrew (platform): agree. I’ll add the RBAC config patch and the audit toggle. Config snippet: 
```yaml
auth:
  rbac:
    audit_level: verbose
    audit_targets: ["siem://builders-unusual-extract"]
```

sec-bot: Created SEC-2025-342 for tracking (CVSS: 7.2, priority: P2). See https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-2025-342

jordan (acct): Can we include a short customer note template for Dedicated customers? I’ll send the 72h notice once you confirm downtime window.

maya (eng-sec): template: "We will perform a security patch and maintenance on Wed 02:00-05:00 UTC. Expected CI build delay up to ~15 minutes per host while builders restart. No impact to inference serving. Contact your CSM for questions." Use channel `#dedicated-notify` for distribution.

andrew (platform): decision: go ahead with canary Tue 02:00 UTC (internal), broad Wed 02:00 UTC if canary clean. Action owners: andrew — patch + restart plan; maya — RBAC audit toggle & verification; olivia — autoscaler pause + health-check collection; jordan — customer comms.

maya (eng-sec): adding mitigation checklist to SEC ticket and enabling temporary alert: `artifact-signature-failure` -> pager during rollout.

olivia (sre): noted. I’ll also schedule a 1hr on-call shadow for the window. :thumbsup:

andrew (platform): final note — we should prepare a rollback image (stable 2.0) and pin it in image registry before starting.

sec-bot: Added comment to SEC-2025-342: "Rollback image prepared: image-builder:stable-2025-11-18"

maya (eng-sec): ok locking this in. Will update the ticket with timeline and customer notice draft.

andrew (platform): thanks — will post a deploy-bot schedule once patch is built.

sec-bot: deploy-bot scheduled: SEC-2025-342 canary (1762099200) and broad (1762185600).
